- **Not checked:** I haven't compared either date with the contract or any other document. I told Marcus to ask Ilse if he needs it confirmed.
- **Still in #north-team:** Ilse's 25 November message and my earlier replies are still there with no correction under them. Anyone reading only that channel could still pick up the wrong date. I haven't posted a correction there because she said no action was needed.
